domain:
Process Description – Care Allowance

The citizen begins by starting application.  Then the citizen needs to submit the information, including the child's age, medical certificate from the specialist and the number of caregivers. Once all information is submitted, the system robots must determine the fact: it must determine whether the age is minor, it must verify the certificate using the verification system, and it must check the child's national insurance membership. All of the above steps needs to be done once.
Based on the robots precheck, the following  rejection consequences are produced:
	• If the certificate is fake, the caseworker must reject it and must not approve it.
	• If the child doesn't have the national insurance membership, the caseworker must reject it and must not approve it.


Once the robot's precheck are passed, the caseworker must manually assess the criteria.

If the child is adult:
	• The caseworker will assess whether the child has developmental disability
	• The caseworker will assess whether the child need continuous supervision (life-threatening case) and care

Otherwise:
	• The caseworker must assess whether the child has illness or disability
	• The caseworker must assess whether the child needs continuous supervision

Moreover, 
	• The caseworker needs to determine whether care requires caregiver absent from work
	• If the citizen input number of caregiver more than 1 during submission, the caseworker must determine whether the care needs justifies a second caregivers.


Once all of the manual assessment is done, if any of the applicable conditions fails, the caseworker will reject it. Otherwise, the caseworker will grant the care allowance.
Additionally, during assessing the criteria, the caseworker must open a case after the robot precheck finishes. After the caseworker open the case, can assess criteria can happen.
Moreover, after the caseworker opened case, he can ask for both similar cases and relevant law. Then the system robot must find the similar cases or relevant laws. Once the finding is complete, the caseworker must review the similar cases or review relevant laws.
During reviewing information of both similar cases or relevant law, the manually assessing the information is blocked until the review is finished. And it also blocks the grant decision as well. 
When grant decision is finished,  the robot must summarize the case and the caseworker must issues assessment and justification after the robot summarization. Until then, the citizen can see the justification after issuing.

entries.text: Hi, extract some roles and entities

I suggest these **four roles**:
- **Citizen** — starts the application, submits information, and views the justification.
- **Caseworker** — assesses criteria, makes decisions, and issues justification.
- **System robot** — performs prechecks, finds supporting information, and summarizes the case.
- **Verification system** — verifies the medical certificate.

And **one entity**:
- **Care allowance application** — holds the lifecycle from application through assessment, decision, and justification. For now, “application” and “case” are treated as the same entity.

The proposed batch adds only these roles and entity. Its validation found no problems.

The checked plan adds **four failure scenarios**, one for each adult/minor assessment.

When an applicable assessment returns **false**:
- Rejection becomes **available and pending**.
- Granting becomes **unavailable**.
- Existing scenarios still record the finding; other assessments remain unchanged.

The caseworker must execute rejection—it is not automatic.

**Timing caveat:** this allows rejection immediately after a failed assessment, rather than waiting until all applicable assessments finish as the process description states.

Declarative specification Care allowance application is submitted means { start application was executed AND submit information was executed AND its child_age is not undefined AND its medical_certificate is not undefined AND its number_of_caregivers is not undefined }

Declarative specification Care allowance application is prechecked means { it is submitted AND determine minor status was executed AND verify medical certificate was executed AND check national insurance membership was executed AND its child_is_minor is not undefined AND its certificate_is_genuine is not undefined AND its child_has_national_insurance_membership is not undefined }

Declarative specification Care allowance application is granted means { it is prechecked AND grant care allowance was executed AND reject application was not executed AND its certificate_is_genuine equal to true AND its child_has_national_insurance_membership equal to true AND its care_requires_absence_from_work equal to true }

Declarative specification Care allowance application is rejected means { it is prechecked AND reject application was executed AND grant care allowance was not executed }

Action assess life threatening continuous supervision and care is enabled means { open case was executed or is not available AND review similar cases is not pending or is not available AND review relevant laws is not pending or is not available }

Action assess_illness_or_disability is enabled means { open case was executed or is not available AND review similar cases is not pending or is not available AND review relevant laws is not pending or is not available }

Scenario: Start application enables submission
Given
  start application is available
  AND start application was not executed
When start application is executed
Then
  start application is not available
  AND submit information is available
  AND submit information is pending.

Scenario: Submit information initiates robot prechecks
Given
  start application was executed
  AND submit information is available
  AND submit information was not executed
When submit information is executed with inputs child_age, medical_certificate, number_of_caregivers
Then
  the Care allowance application's child_age is set to child_age
  AND the Care allowance application's medical_certificate is set to medical_certificate
  AND the Care allowance application's number_of_caregivers is set to number_of_caregivers
  AND submit information is not available
  AND determine minor status is available
  AND determine minor status is pending
  AND verify medical certificate is available
  AND verify medical certificate is pending
  AND check national insurance membership is available
  AND check national insurance membership is pending.

Scenario: Determine minor status records robot finding
Given
  submit information was executed
  AND determine minor status is available
  AND determine minor status was not executed
When determine minor status is executed with outputs child_is_minor
Then
  the Care allowance application's child_is_minor is set to child_is_minor
  AND determine minor status is not available.

Scenario: Verify medical certificate records robot finding
Given
  submit information was executed
  AND verify medical certificate is available
  AND verify medical certificate was not executed
When verify medical certificate is executed with outputs certificate_is_genuine
Then
  the Care allowance application's certificate_is_genuine is set to certificate_is_genuine
  AND verify medical certificate is not available.

Scenario: Check national insurance membership records robot finding
Given
  submit information was executed
  AND check national insurance membership is available
  AND check national insurance membership was not executed
When check national insurance membership is executed with outputs child_has_national_insurance_membership
Then
  the Care allowance application's child_has_national_insurance_membership is set to child_has_national_insurance_membership
  AND check national insurance membership is not available.

Scenario: Minor status completes successful prechecks
Given
  determine minor status is available
  AND determine minor status was not executed
  AND verify medical certificate was executed
  AND check national insurance membership was executed
  AND the Care allowance application's certificate_is_genuine equal to true
  AND the Care allowance application's child_has_national_insurance_membership equal to true
When determine minor status is executed with outputs child_is_minor
Then
  open case is available
  AND open case is pending.

Scenario: Certificate verification completes successful prechecks
Given
  verify medical certificate is available
  AND verify medical certificate was not executed
  AND determine minor status was executed
  AND check national insurance membership was executed
  AND the Care allowance application's child_has_national_insurance_membership equal to true
When verify medical certificate is executed with outputs certificate_is_genuine = true
Then
  open case is available
  AND open case is pending.

Scenario: Membership check completes successful prechecks
Given
  check national insurance membership is available
  AND check national insurance membership was not executed
  AND determine minor status was executed
  AND verify medical certificate was executed
  AND the Care allowance application's certificate_is_genuine equal to true
When check national insurance membership is executed with outputs child_has_national_insurance_membership = true
Then
  open case is available
  AND open case is pending.

Scenario: Fake certificate requires rejection
Given
  verify medical certificate is available
  AND verify medical certificate was not executed
When verify medical certificate is executed with outputs certificate_is_genuine = false
Then
  reject application is available
  AND reject application is pending
  AND grant care allowance is not available
  AND open case is not available.

Scenario: Missing insurance membership requires rejection
Given
  check national insurance membership is available
  AND check national insurance membership was not executed
When check national insurance membership is executed with outputs child_has_national_insurance_membership = false
Then
  reject application is available
  AND reject application is pending
  AND grant care allowance is not available
  AND open case is not available.

Scenario: Open case begins manual assessment stage
Given
  the Care allowance application is prechecked
  AND the Care allowance application's certificate_is_genuine equal to true
  AND the Care allowance application's child_has_national_insurance_membership equal to true
  AND open case is available
  AND open case was not executed
When open case is executed
Then
  open case is not available
  AND determine_caregiver_absence_from_work_requirement is available
  AND determine_caregiver_absence_from_work_requirement is pending
  AND request similar cases is available
  AND request relevant laws is available.

Scenario: Open adult case requires adult assessments
Given
  the Care allowance application is prechecked
  AND the Care allowance application's certificate_is_genuine equal to true
  AND the Care allowance application's child_has_national_insurance_membership equal to true
  AND the Care allowance application's child_is_minor equal to false
  AND open case is available
  AND open case was not executed
When open case is executed
Then
  assess developmental disability is available
  AND assess developmental disability is pending
  AND assess life threatening continuous supervision and care is available
  AND assess life threatening continuous supervision and care is pending.

Scenario: Open minor case requires minor assessments
Given
  the Care allowance application is prechecked
  AND the Care allowance application's certificate_is_genuine equal to true
  AND the Care allowance application's child_has_national_insurance_membership equal to true
  AND the Care allowance application's child_is_minor equal to true
  AND open case is available
  AND open case was not executed
When open case is executed
Then
  assess_illness_or_disability is available
  AND assess_illness_or_disability is pending
  AND assess continuous supervision is available
  AND assess continuous supervision is pending.

Scenario: Open case with multiple caregivers requires justification assessment
Given
  the Care allowance application is prechecked
  AND the Care allowance application's certificate_is_genuine equal to true
  AND the Care allowance application's child_has_national_insurance_membership equal to true
  AND the Care allowance application's number_of_caregivers larger than 1
  AND open case is available
  AND open case was not executed
When open case is executed
Then
  assess second caregiver justification is available
  AND assess second caregiver justification is pending.
